name: Captain Stoutfist
summary: At Menethil Harbor, Captain Stoutfist directs the defense against Dragonmaw attacks. The dwarf officer coordinates the garrison’s defenses and counterstrikes to keep the Alliance port from falling.

sections.title: Defender of Menethil
sections.body: Menethil Harbor is the principal deepwater port linking Ironforge and Stormwind to the Wetlands and the sea beyond. Captain Stoutfist commands the town’s defense, guarding its docks, people, and garrison from the dangers around them. The marshlands are hazardous, but the greatest threat is an organized advance by renegade orcs.

sections.title: The Dragonmaw Threat
sections.body: The Dragonmaw clan has held strongholds in the Wetlands since the Second War and now presses toward the roads and mountain passes. By infiltrating Dun Algaz, the orcs threaten the overland route linking Loch Modan and Ironforge with Menethil Harbor. Stoutfist has too few troops, so he depends on Alliance volunteers sent by Mountaineer Valstag Ironjaw to hold them back.

sections.title: Striking at Nek'rosh
sections.body: Captain Stoutfist leads a campaign against the orc camps rather than waiting for a siege. He directs allied forces to capture war banners near Whelgar's Excavation Site, sabotage Dragonmaw catapults preparing to attack, and kill Nek'rosh Skullcrusher, the clan’s ruthless local chieftain. Stoutfist seeks to break the orc offensive before Menethil Harbor is overwhelmed.

faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist commands the dwarf forces defending Menethil Harbor. He organizes the garrison’s defenses, weighs threats across the region, and recruits volunteers to drive back enemies threatening the port.
Captain Stoutfist is stationed inside Menethil Harbor, the main Alliance hub on the Wetlands’ western coast.

faq.q: Why does Captain Stoutfist need outside help?
faq.answer: The local garrison is stretched thin across the Wetlands. Dragonmaw orcs have seized the mountain passes at Dun Algaz and are pressing toward town, leaving Stoutfist short of troops to strike back and guard the harbor at once.
Nek'rosh Skullcrusher leads the Dragonmaw orcs operating in the Wetlands. Captain Stoutfist orders his death to disrupt the orcs’ coordination and protect Menethil Harbor from a full assault.

faq.q: How does Dun Algaz connect to Captain Stoutfist's mission?
faq.answer: Dun Algaz is the vital mountain pass linking Loch Modan and Ironforge to the Wetlands. When Dragonmaw orcs pushed into the pass, Mountaineer Valstag Ironjaw warned that Menethil was in danger and sent adventurers to help Captain Stoutfist reinforce the harbor.

faq.q: What threat do the Dragonmaw catapults pose?
faq.answer: Dragonmaw catapults could batter Menethil Harbor’s fortifications in a direct siege. Stoutfist directs champions to sabotage them before they reach firing range.

angles.text: Captain Stoutfist defends one of the Alliance’s most important maritime hubs, keeping naval routes open between Khaz Modan, Stormwind, and distant outposts.
As a dwarf, you can see Ironforge’s military resolve in Stoutfist, entrusted with guarding vital lowland infrastructure far below the mountain peaks.
As a warrior, you’ll find Stoutfist a blunt tactician who favors bold strikes over cautious fortification, sending warriors to destroy enemy artillery and leadership.
